title: ReConMem: A Graph-Based Dual Memory System for Repository-Oriented Conversations
title_zh: ReConMem：面向仓库导向对话的基于图的双记忆系统

paragraphs.en: ReConMem用图结构对齐对话记忆与代码实体，显著提升仓库导向对话基准表现。 LLM-based code assistants are increasingly used in iterative repository-level development, where effective assistance requires jointly leveraging evolving conversational history and repository context. Existing memory systems, however, are primarily designed for general-purpose conversations and do not sufficiently coordinate conversational information with the structured code entities to which it refers. We propose ReConMem, a graph-based dual memory system for repository-oriented conversations. ReConMem organizes distilled conversational memories and conversation-relevant code entities into interconnected semantic and structural memory graphs, while maintaining their cross-graph associations as interactions evolve. For memory recall, ReConMem combines natural-language and code-aligned retrieval through code-draft-based query grounding, expands retrieved information over intra- and inter-graph relations, and compresses retrieved code according to its structural granularity. We evaluate ReConMem on two repository-oriented conversational benchmarks spanning long-horizon context management and realistic project-grounded multi-turn assistance. On LoCoEval, ReConMem improves Pass@1 over the strongest baseline by 7.917 and 7.292 percentage points on single-hop and multi-hop subsets, respectively, with comparable context compression. On CodeAssistBench, it achieves 27.61% Correct and 44.03% Partially Correct, exceeding Full History by 4.10 and 7.09 percentage points, respectively, while improving interaction quality. These results demonstrate that aligning conversational memory with repository structure improves context management for repository-oriented multi-turn interactions.
paragraphs.zh: ReConMem用图结构对齐对话记忆与代码实体，显著提升仓库导向对话基准表现。基于大语言模型的代码助手在迭代式仓库级开发中的应用日益增多，在此场景下，有效辅助需要联合利用不断演化的对话历史与仓库上下文。 然而，现有的记忆系统主要面向通用对话设计，未能充分协调对话信息与其所指的结构化代码实体。 我们提出ReConMem，一种面向仓库导向对话的基于图的双记忆系统。 ReConMem将提炼后的对话记忆与对话相关的代码实体组织为相互连接的语义记忆图和结构记忆图，并在交互演化的过程中持续维护二者的跨图关联。 在记忆召回方面，ReConMem通过基于代码草稿的查询锚定结合自然语言检索与代码对齐检索，在图内与图间关系上扩展检索到的信息，并根据结构粒度对检索到的代码进行压缩。 我们在两个仓库导向对话基准上评估ReConMem，涵盖长程上下文管理与基于真实项目的多轮辅助。 在LoCoEval上，ReConMem在单跳和多跳子集上分别将Pass@1较最强基线提升7.917和7.292个百分点，同时保持相当的上下文压缩率。 在CodeAssistBench上，它取得27.61%的正确率和44.03%的部分正确率，分别超过完整历史方法4.10和7.09个百分点，同时提升了交互质量。 这些结果表明，将对话记忆与仓库结构对齐能够改善仓库导向多轮交互的上下文管理。
